ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Usage Of ShellExec_RunDLL
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious usage of the ShellExec_RunDLL function to launch other commands as seen in the the raspberry-robin attack

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*ShellExec\\_RunDLL.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Desktop\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*comspec.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*iex.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*msiexec.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*odbcconf.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*regsvr32.*")))
